settings.search.label: Search settings
settings.section.appearance.label: Appearance and brand
settings.section.appearance.lead: Changes apply at once for everyone, with undo. Values from the file or the environment are locked.

settings.section.general.label: General
settings.section.general.lead: Defaults for everyone who has not chosen their own, and how the server logs.
settings.section.general.keywords: start page time zone week log
settings.section.network.label: Network, HTTPS and proxy
settings.section.network.lead: Addresses, certificates and reverse proxies. Addresses and certificate files are set in kalzit.toml or the environment only, so a wrong value here can never lock anyone out; certificates from Let’s Encrypt or another ACME authority are set up below.
settings.section.network.keywords: port address tls ssl certificate https http proxy url forwarded acme lets encrypt renewal
settings.section.security.label: Sessions and security
settings.section.security.lead: How long sign-ins last, HSTS and the limit on failed sign-ins. Set in kalzit.toml or the environment.
settings.section.security.keywords: session cookie hsts login brute force rate limit timeout
settings.section.signin.label: Sign-in
settings.section.signin.lead: How people sign in: providers, group mapping, local sign-in and the second factor.
settings.section.signin.keywords: sso single sign-on oidc openid ldap active directory entra keycloak

settings.section.email.label: Email

settings.section.datasources.label: Data sources and targets
settings.section.datasources.lead: Where data sources may connect and what a single query may cost.

settings.queryCache.title: Query cache now

settings.section.orgAi.keywords: ai llm provider limits usage data sources access excluded fields
settings.section.plugins.label: Plugins
settings.section.plugins.lead: More data sources and panels. Each plugin runs sealed off, a data source as a process of its own in a sandbox, a panel in a frame of its own, and only with a valid, trusted signature.

settings.section.orgPlugins.lead: Which of the server’s plugins this organization offers.
settings.section.orgPlugins.keywords: plugins block offer data source kinds
settings.section.storage.label: Storage and retention
settings.section.storage.lead: How long the server keeps history.
settings.section.storage.keywords: audit log retention versions history delete
settings.section.updates.label: Updates
settings.section.organization.label: Organization {name}
settings.section.organization.lead: The look and defaults of this organization. A value set to “Like the server” follows the server.
settings.section.organization.keywords: organization org team look accent density start page time zone
settings.section.profile.label: Profile and language
settings.section.profile.lead: Your name, language, theme, time zone, password and sessions.
settings.section.profile.keywords: account name password language theme sessions sign out
settings.section.shortcuts.label: Keyboard shortcuts
settings.section.shortcuts.lead: Every shortcut of the app. Press ? anywhere to see them.
settings.section.transfer.label: Export / import settings
settings.section.transfer.lead: Move settings between servers as a JSON file. Only settings you may change are exported; secrets never are.
settings.section.transfer.keywords: backup export import json file copy
settings.lockHint.file: Set in kalzit.toml. Change it there; it cannot be changed here.
settings.lockHint.env: Set by an environment variable (KALZIT_*). Change it there; it cannot be changed here.
settings.lockHint.config: Can only be set in kalzit.toml or the environment.
settings.accent.label: Accent color
settings.accent.customLead: A color as #rrggbb. It needs 3:1 against the light and the dark page and 4.5:1 for the label on it.
settings.accent.contrast: Contrast: {dark}:1 on dark, {light}:1 on light, {label}:1 for the label
settings.accent.tooLow: Too little contrast. Choose a darker or more saturated color.
settings.logo.label: Logo
settings.logo.description: Appears in the sidebar, on the sign-in page and in the browser tab. PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 256 KiB.
settings.logo.restored: The change to the logo was undone.
settings.logo.wrongType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
settings.logo.tooLarge: The image is larger than 256 KiB.
settings.signInPage.label: Sign-in page
settings.signInPage.description: Your own welcome text and a notice, such as privacy or a maintenance window.
settings.signInPage.title: Sign-in page
settings.signInPage.welcomeHint: Replaces the line under the heading. At most 280 characters.
settings.signInPage.noticeHint: Shown above the form. At most 2000 characters.
settings.signInPage.markdown: Plain text. **bold**, *italic* and [links](https://example.org) work; a blank line starts a paragraph.
settings.signInPage.empty: Nothing set; the sign-in page shows its usual text.
settings.preview.title: Preview
settings.theme.ownHint: The default applies to everyone without a theme of their own.
settings.preview.label: Preview of the look
settings.preview.contrast: Accent contrast: {dark}:1 on dark, {light}:1 on light
settings.preview.vetted: A vetted color: it meets the contrast rules in every theme.
settings.planned.title: Not available yet
settings.updates.text: Channel, daily check and maintenance window are set on the Updates page, next to new versions and backups.
settings.transfer.exportServerHint: Everything on this server you may change, without values from kalzit.toml or the environment.
settings.transfer.exportOrgHint: The look and defaults of this organization.
settings.transfer.importHint: Choose a file exported from a Kalzit server. You see every change before anything is applied.
settings.transfer.notJson: The file is not valid JSON.
settings.transfer.noAccess: You may not change these settings.
settings.section.about.label: About Kalzit
settings.section.about.lead: Version, license and the software Kalzit is built on.
settings.section.about.keywords: about version build commit license licence agpl open source source code copyright third party packages credits company mousewerk github security website
settings.about.tagline: Calcite, the sunstone that makes hidden structure visible.
settings.about.meaning: Calcite is a crystal that splits a ray of light in two. Kalzit does the same for your data: it keeps documents, graphs and tables in their own shape and shows the structure that stays hidden in a flat view.
settings.about.name: Name
settings.about.warning.databasePasswordI: kalzit.toml holds the database password, which everyone who may read the file sees. Give the database URL in KALZIT_DATABASE_URL_FILE or a credential instead.
settings.about.loadError: The build information could not be loaded.
settings.about.licenseName: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0
settings.about.licenseNote: You may run, study, change and share Kalzit freely. Running it unchanged for your own use needs nothing more. If you distribute it, you must pass on the license text and the source code. If you change it and let others use your version over a network, you must offer them the source code of your version under the same license.
settings.about.cleanRoomText: Independently developed, without code from other dashboard products.
settings.about.thirdPartyLead: The Rust crates and npm packages that ship with Kalzit.
settings.about.licensesMissing: The list of third-party licenses is created when Kalzit is built; this build has none.
settings.about.notices: Full license texts of these packages
settings.acme.title: Automatic certificates (ACME)
settings.acme.saved: Certificate settings saved. Kalzit orders the certificate in the background.
settings.acme.conflict: Someone else saved these settings in the meantime. Their values are shown now; check them and save again.
settings.acme.certificateFiles: HTTPS uses the certificate files from kalzit.toml (tls.cert_file). To let Kalzit order certificates, remove tls.cert_file and tls.key_file and restart it.
settings.acme.httpsOff: HTTPS is off. With HTTP-01, Kalzit can order the certificate already; then set server.https_addr in kalzit.toml (for example 0.0.0.0:443) and restart Kalzit to serve it.
settings.acme.enabled.label: Order certificates automatically
settings.acme.enabled.description: Kalzit orders the HTTPS certificate for the names below and renews it before it expires.
settings.acme.directory.label: Certificate authority
settings.acme.directory.letsencryptHint: Free certificates that browsers trust, valid for 90 days.
settings.acme.directory.stagingHint: For trying the setup: generous limits, but browsers do not trust these certificates.
settings.acme.directory.customHint: Any certificate authority that offers ACME, for example an internal one.
settings.acme.directoryUrl.label: ACME address
settings.acme.directoryUrl.description: The https:// address where the certificate authority offers ACME (its directory).
settings.acme.directoryCa.label: CA certificate
settings.acme.directoryCa.description: Optional, as PEM: trusted for the ACME address in addition to the system’s certificates.
settings.acme.domains.label: Names
settings.acme.domains.description: One per line. Each must point to this server in DNS.
settings.acme.email.label: Contact email
settings.acme.email.description: Optional. The certificate authority writes here about expiring certificates and problems.
settings.acme.challenge.label: Validation
settings.acme.challenge.http: The certificate authority fetches a token over HTTP on port 80; HTTP listens on {address}.
settings.acme.challenge.alpn: The certificate authority connects over TLS on port 443; HTTPS listens on {address}.
settings.acme.terms.label: Accept the terms of service
settings.acme.terms.description: The certificate authority issues certificates only once its terms are accepted. “Test connection” shows the link.
settings.acme.testPassed: The certificate authority answers and every name resolves.
settings.acme.status.title: HTTPS certificate
settings.acme.status.storeError: Not stored yet, Kalzit tries again: {reason}
settings.mail.title: Mail server
settings.mail.serverHint: Host and port of the mail server; an empty port takes the usual one of the encryption.
settings.mail.starttlsHint: Plain first, then STARTTLS before anything else; usually port 587.
settings.mail.tlsHint: TLS from the first byte; usually port 465.
settings.mail.noneHint: Only from kalzit.toml, for a relay on this computer.
settings.mail.usernameHint: Empty when the mail server takes mail without signing in.
settings.mail.passwordHint: Kept in the vault, never shown again.
settings.mail.passwordStored: Stored and never shown again. Leave empty to keep it; another server or user needs it again.
settings.mail.fromNameHint: How Kalzit appears in the inbox.
settings.mail.fromAddressHint: The address the mail server allows as sender.
settings.mail.replyToHint: Where answers to the mails of Kalzit go.
settings.mail.testHint: Sends one mail with the values in the form, saved or not.
settings.mail.checkField: Check the marked field. Saving waits for a successful test mail; until then the previous setting applies.
settings.mail.testFirst: Send a test mail with these values first, then save.
settings.mail.conflict: Someone else saved the mail server meanwhile; the form now shows that version.
settings.mail.removeText: Afterwards invitations appear as links to copy, and there are no password links.
settings.mail.noneText: Invitations appear as links to copy; admins reset passwords in the administration.
settings.mail.locked: These values come from kalzit.toml or the environment (KALZIT_SMTP_*) and cannot be changed here. A test mail still works.
settings.mail.publicUrlMissing: Without a public address (server.public_url) Kalzit sends no links: no invitations and no password links.
settings.mail.sends.title: What Kalzit sends by mail
